dogecoin.text:
Bought 100 shares of $VTRS during Dogecoin mania.
 
$13 each. So confident prices would climb, sold a $15 long-dated put as well.
 
Up 25% on buy and hold shares alone in a little over one month.

Supply shortages, infrastructure breakdowns, scuttling incompetent bugmen in office.
 
Meanwhile, all of the most talented and smartest people have congregated together to make memes and manipulate Dogecoin / AMC.
 
Atlas Shrugged is real.

Tired:
 
Cold emailing small businesses about your social media marketing agency.
 
Wired: Pitching "Dogecoin Standard" or "AMC Share Reserve" to presidents of Mauritania and Vanuatu.

Why isn't anyone Tweeting:
 
"Gerald, 55, bought Exxon stock. Travis, 22, bought Dogecoin."
 
Anymore?
